headline: EPS swings to profit after last year's loss
summary_short: ENEOS Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥154.64, up 221.2% q/q from ¥48.14.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥154.64 rose 221.2% sequentially from ¥48.14 in the prior quarter, and swung to a profit from a year-ago loss of ¥5.40 per share. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
